principle: This policy supplies scoped negative sources for the author to assess against the current depiction. Select the constraints the image needs and express them in the target's supported form. A single prose channel may carry direct exclusions or positive construction; polarity alone does not decide meaning.

generation_hygiene.activation: character-image generation where incidental marks are unrelated to the requested design
guards_against: text, logos, watermarks, or signatures the design did not ask for

quality_floor.activation: the target family trains a quality or aesthetic ladder
guards_against: the low-scoring slice of the family's training corpus

single_picture.activation: the selected depiction is one continuous view and excludes panels, a sheet or additional views; output count alone does not establish this choice

requested_content_rating.activation: the request fixes a content rating and the target family carries rating terms
guards_against: a content tier above the requested one

visible_limb_integrity.activation: arms, legs, wings, tentacles, or other articulated limbs are visibly framed

hand_or_paw_integrity.activation: a visible hand, paw, claw, or manipulator performs a readable action

tail_integrity.activation: the selected subject has a visible tail
guards_against: tail fused into a nearby form

held_prop_integrity.activation: the subject holds, wears, leans on, or otherwise contacts a prop

observed_generation_failure.activation: a reviewed result shows a failure or a drift from what the positive states, to correct on retry

user_exclusion.activation: the user explicitly excludes a concept or presentation

selected_render_profile.activation: the author selects a supported medium-drift boundary within the scope where the render profile is applied

selected_style_family.activation: the author selects a supported medium-drift boundary within the scope where the style family is applied

semantic_exclusion_rule.guidance: A negative names only what an active source guards against, including a drift a reviewed result showed; add other concepts, themes, and presentations only when the user explicitly excludes them.

merge_rule: Assess each source against the complete intended artifact, explicit requirements and applicable evidence. Preserve the source scope in the selected constraint. A whole-image negative must hold throughout the image; another region may intentionally use the treatment excluded locally. If the interface cannot express a needed local exclusion, describe that local construction positively. Select only necessary constraints and consolidate redundant wording within their scopes.
applicability_rule: Judge applicability from the intended scene, anatomy, wardrobe, props, camera and finish, including required details the draft has missed. Decide whether a constraint is needed from that full context. An unmentioned structure does not automatically require a negative bundle or an instruction declaring it absent, occluded or out of frame.
